_: The invented world every frame of the promos and walkthroughs is filmed in. Nothing here is a real person, computer, path or business. The two agents are real: Louise and Bryn, the free WilsonWorks agents in agents/catalog.json, installed by their keys from their GitHub sources the way anyone gets them; only their ports and what they are doing on the day are set here. capture/install.js installs the three sandbox computers from it; capture/seed.js fills them with an invented working day; the videos draw the diagrams from it.

computers.name: DESK
computers.duty: Plans, reviews and merges. Runs the office.

computers.name: MINI
computers.duty: Works on branches while you are away. Never merges.

computers.name: LAPTOP
computers.duty: On the go: drafts and pushes branches.

projects.line: A web app that plans a vegetable garden.
The website for a neighbourhood bakery.

agents._: install-agent louise --port 7660 on DESK. A sandbox port, from 7660 to 7669: her default, 7540, may be a real Louise on the filming computer, and a sandbox office must never open a real door. --port rewrites probe.port and door.local in her agent.json, which is where the office looks for her and where her server reads its port. stage is what seed.js sets with her own command, node engine/stage.js set, as her runbook does.

stage: Should the bakery website take orders, or only show the menu?
agents._: install-agent bryn --port 7661 on DESK, for the same reason (her default is 7550). stage is set with her own node engine/stage.js set.
